title_en: Supreme People's Court 2010 Publicity Case on Combating Obscene and Pornographic Information Crimes
keywords_en: case of criminal dissemination of obscene and pornographic information
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

2010 Publicity Cases on Cracking Down on Crimes of Obscene and Pornographic Information

Case 1: Wei Dawei, Qi Benhou — Crime of Disseminating Obscene Materials for Profit

Basic Facts

Defendant: Wei Dawei, male, Han ethnicity, born on October 23, 1981, unemployed.

Defendant: Qi Benhou, male, Han ethnicity, born on February 23, 1981, unemployed.

Defendant Wei Dawei, for the purpose of seeking profits, beginning in August 2008, successively established obscene websites such as "Sex Sister," "Incest Mature Woman," "Just Go for Sex," and "Deer City Entertainment" on the Internet. Wei Dawei placed advertisements for defendant Qi Benhou on the above websites he operated and made a profit of RMB 3,000. Upon appraisal, the first three websites contained obscene material; the "Deer City Entertainment" website contained 26 videos and 792 pictures and articles that were obscene.

Defendant Qi Benhou, in 2009, established the "Ai Zhilin Adult Products" website on the Internet. To seek profits, he expanded sales of adult products by placing advertisements on obscene websites. Upon appraisal, the 32 websites on which "Ai Zhilin Adult Products" placed advertisements were obscene. Apart from placing advertisements on the 32 obscene websites, the website operated by Qi Benhou also placed advertisements on the obscene "Deer City Entertainment" website.

Judgment

The court held that defendant Wei Dawei, for the purpose of seeking profits, disseminated 26 obscene videos and 792 pictures and articles through the Internet, and his conduct has constituted the crime of disseminating obscene materials for profit. Defendant Qi Benhou, for the purpose of seeking profits, knowingly placed advertisements on 33 obscene websites, and his conduct has constituted the crime of disseminating obscene materials for profit. Accordingly, in accordance with law, defendant Wei Dawei was sentenced to two years and six months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 10,000; and Qi Benhou was sentenced to one year and eight months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 10,000.

Case 2: Suo Qimu, Wang Jiamei, Luo Jingdong, Guo Jianing — Crime of Disseminating Obscene Materials for Profit

Basic Facts

Defendant: Suo Qimu, male, Han ethnicity, born on May 9, 1976, unemployed.

Defendant: Wang Jiamei, female, Han ethnicity, born on April 28, 1986, unemployed.

Defendant: Luo Jingdong, male, Han ethnicity, born on October 7, 1987, unemployed.

Defendant: Guo Jianing, male, Han ethnicity, born on February 28, 1991, unemployed. On February 26, 2008, he was sentenced by the Meijiang District People's Court of Meizhou, Guangdong Province, to one year's imprisonment, suspended for two years.

Between September 26, 2009 and January 2010, defendant Suo Qimu, with the help of defendant Wang Jiamei, leased a virtual host and registered a website named "Girls' Selection." Later, the website joined the "Eight Directions Advertising Alliance" and became its official member website. To profit by increasing the click rate of advertisements on the website, Suo Qimu posted electronic information with obscene content on the "Girls' Selection" website. By the time the case was discovered, the website contained 204 video files, 160 pictures, and 72 articles, all of which were appraised as obscene. During this period, Wang Jiamei helped Suo Qimu download obscene pictures for updating the website content, promoted the website, and provided her personal bank card for settlement by the "Eight Directions Advertising Alliance" for the "Girls' Selection" website. In September 2009, defendant Luo Jingdong, the founder of the "Eight Directions Advertising Alliance," employed defendant Guo Jianing to recruit websites with obscene content to become member websites of the alliance via QQ chat. Upon appraisal, as of February 2010, among the member websites of the "Eight Directions Advertising Alliance" recruited by Luo Jingdong and Guo Jianing, 27 websites had obscene content, and Luo Jingdong had provided fee settlement services for 13 of them. Luo Jingdong paid a total of RMB 12,490 to the 13 websites, charging a 10% fee, and thus profited approximately RMB 1,387. From September 26, 2009 to January 5, 2010 when the case was discovered, the obscene electronic information on the "Girls' Selection" website was actually clicked a cumulative total of 775,331 times. Defendant Luo Jingdong settled three times for the "Girls' Selection" website of defendants Suo Qimu and Wang Jiamei, which was recruited and examined by defendant Guo Jianing, paying a total of RMB 479.

Judgment

The court held that defendants Suo Qimu and Wang Jiamei, for the purpose of seeking profits, disseminated obscene electronic information through the Internet, and the circumstances were particularly serious; defendants Luo Jingdong and Guo Jianing, knowingly being obscene websites, for the purpose of seeking profits, provided fee settlement services for obscene websites by means of placing advertisements. All four defendants have constituted the crime of disseminating obscene materials for profit. Moreover, the four defendants constituted a joint crime. Based on the criminal facts, nature, circumstances, and degree of harm to society of defendants Suo Qimu, Wang Jiamei, Luo Jingdong, and Guo Jianing, and the circumstance that the family members of Luo Jingdong and Guo Jianing voluntarily prepaid the fines, in accordance with law, Suo Qimu was sentenced to 11 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 2,395; Wang Jiamei was sentenced to 10 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 1,437; Luo Jingdong was sentenced to one year and six months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 6,935; the suspended sentence portion of the second count of the Criminal Judgment (2008) Mei District Criminal First Instance No. 31 of the Meijiang District People's Court of Meizhou, Guangdong Province, which sentenced defendant Guo Jianing to one year's imprisonment, suspended for two years, and a fine of RMB 10,000 for the crime of robbery, was revoked. Guo Jianing was sentenced to one year's imprisonment and a fine of RMB 4,161, to be merged with the punishment for the robbery crime, and the executed sentence was fixed at two years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 14,161.

Case 3: Chen Jinpeng, Zhang Bo (Sichuan), Zhang Bo (Hubei), Lu Jinxiang, An Zhicheng — Crime of Disseminating Obscene Materials for Profit

Basic Facts

Defendant: Chen Jinpeng, male, Han ethnicity, born on February 23, 1989, person in charge of Chengdu Wangyuan Technology Co., Ltd., Sichuan Province, and operator of a certain pornographic website.

Defendant: Zhang Bo (Sichuan), male, Han ethnicity, born on October 1, 1980, employee of Chengdu Wangyuan Technology Co., Ltd., Sichuan Province.

Defendant: Zhang Bo (Hubei), male, Han ethnicity, born on March 23, 1987, employee of a certain pornographic website.

Defendant: Lu Jinxiang, male, Han ethnicity, born on November 5, 1979, employee of a certain pornographic website.

Defendant: An Zhicheng, male, Han ethnicity, born on November 7, 1986, operator of Liuling Technology Company.

In January 2008, defendant Chen Jinpeng leased a server from defendant An Zhicheng of Liuling Technology Company to establish a pornographic website. An Zhicheng leased the relevant server to Chen Jinpeng for establishing the pornographic website and collected service fees totaling over RMB 20,000 from Chen Jinpeng. In September 2008, Chen Jinpeng used new program software written by defendant Zhang Bo (Sichuan) to rename the above website, and sought illegal profits by renting advertisement space on the website and selling goods through advertisements. To operate the pornographic website, Chen Jinpeng employed defendant Lu Jinxiang to download pornographic pictures, novels, and other materials from other pornographic websites and upload them to the website; employed Zhang Bo (Hubei) to maintain and update the website; and had Zhang Bo (Sichuan) provide related programming services. In June and July 2009, Chen Bingrong rented advertisement space on the pornographic website and remitted a total of RMB 160,000 to Chen Jinpeng in two installments. Chen Jinpeng received RMB 160,000 as rent for the website advertisement space paid by Chen Bingrong. The public security organs extracted pictures from the website established by Chen Jinpeng for appraisal. Upon appraisal, 2,046 pictures were found to be obscene articles.

In addition, it was found that from the evening of July 26, 2009 to the evening of July 27, 2009, a domain name resolution server hosted at the Wujin IDC room located at Fudong Road, Wujin District, Changzhou City, Jiangsu Province, under China Telecom Co., Ltd., Changzhou Branch, suffered an abnormal network traffic attack, causing the domain name resolution service provided by that server to fail, leading to an increase in DNS server traffic of the Jiangsu Telecom department, triggering the abnormal filtering mechanism of the Jiangsu Telecom Blackhole 2000 system, so that normal domain name resolution requests from users were filtered out, resulting in a large number of users in Jiangsu Province being unable to log in to the Internet normally. Upon investigation, that domain name resolution server provided DNS domain name resolution for the pornographic website operated by Chen Jinpeng.

Judgment

The court held that defendants Chen Jinpeng, Zhang Bo (Sichuan), Zhang Bo (Hubei), and Lu Jinxiang, for the purpose of seeking profits, disseminated obscene pictures through the Internet; defendant An Zhicheng provided services such as Internet access, server hosting, network storage space, and communication transmission channels for the obscene website, collecting service fees in excess of RMB 20,000; their conduct has constituted the crime of disseminating obscene materials for profit. Among them, Chen Jinpeng and An Zhicheng, and Chen Jinpeng with Zhang Bo (Sichuan), Zhang Bo (Hubei), and Lu Jinxiang constituted joint crimes. Chen Jinpeng, Zhang Bo (Sichuan), Zhang Bo (Hubei), and Lu Jinxiang disseminated 2,046 obscene pictures, which constitutes a serious circumstance. An Zhicheng, knowing it was an obscene website, provided server hosting and other services and collected service fees, and shall be convicted and punished for the crime of disseminating obscene materials for profit. Chen Jinpeng played a principal role in the joint crime with An Zhicheng and in the joint crime with Zhang Bo (Sichuan), Zhang Bo (Hubei), and Lu Jinxiang, and is the principal offender, and shall be punished for all the crimes in which he participated; An Zhicheng played a secondary role in the joint crime with Chen Jinpeng, and Zhang Bo (Sichuan), Zhang Bo (Hubei), and Lu Jinxiang played secondary roles in the joint crime with Chen Jinpeng, and are all accomplices. Zhang Bo (Sichuan), Zhang Bo (Hubei), and Lu Jinxiang shall be given mitigated punishment according to law, and An Zhicheng shall be given a lighter punishment according to law. After Chen Jinpeng was brought to justice, he provided important clues and assisted the public security organs in arresting other criminal suspects, constituting meritorious service, and may be given mitigated punishment according to law. Chen Jinpeng, Zhang Bo (Sichuan), Zhang Bo (Hubei), Lu Jinxiang, and An Zhicheng had a good attitude in admitting guilt after being brought to justice and showed repentance, and may be given a lighter punishment as appropriate. Accordingly, in accordance with law, defendant Chen Jinpeng was sentenced to two years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 600,000; Zhang Bo (Sichuan) was sentenced to one year and two months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 200,000; Zhang Bo (Hubei) was sentenced to one year and two months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 200,000; Lu Jinxiang was sentenced to one year and two months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 200,000; An Zhicheng was sentenced to one year and one month's imprisonment and a fine of RMB 150,000.

Case 4: Sheng Xisong, Cheng Wei, Xie Mingshuan, Xie Xu, Wan Shan, Yang Dongsheng, Liu Cong — Crime of Disseminating Obscene Materials for Profit

Basic Facts

Defendant: Sheng Xisong, male, Han ethnicity, born on July 1, 1981, legal representative of Hefei Tianmei Network Technology Co., Ltd.

Defendant: Cheng Wei, male, Han ethnicity, born on April 20, 1983, employee of Hefei Tianmei Network Technology Co., Ltd.

Defendant: Xie Mingshuan, male, Han ethnicity, born on May 7, 1980, employee of Hefei Tianmei Network Technology Co., Ltd.

Defendant: Xie Xu, male, Han ethnicity, born on April 8, 1987, employee of Hefei Tianmei Network Technology Co., Ltd.

Defendant: Wan Shan, male, Han ethnicity, born on May 9, 1986, employee of Hefei Tianmei Network Technology Co., Ltd.

Defendant: Yang Dongsheng, male, Han ethnicity, born on October 14, 1988, employee of Hefei Tianmei Network Technology Co., Ltd.

Defendant: Liu Cong, male, Han ethnicity, born on June 16, 1989, employee of Hefei Tianmei Network Technology Co., Ltd.

In October 2006, defendant Sheng Xisong registered and established Hefei Tianmei Network Technology Co., Ltd., and set up servers at the China Mobile Nujiang Data Center at Building 10, Zone A, Lane 1340, Jinshajiang Road, Shanghai, and in Ma'anshan City, Anhui Province, among other places. The company mainly engaged in computer software development, e-commerce, information consulting services, etc. Sheng Xisong was the legal representative of the company and was responsible for its operation and management. To seek illegal profits, from May 2008 to May 2009, Sheng Xisong successively employed defendants Cheng Wei, Xie Mingshuan, Xie Xu, Wan Shan, Yang Dongsheng, Liu Cong, and others at the company's office in Room A2-519, Angao City Tiandi Community, No. 99 Wangjiang Road, Hefei City, Anhui Province, to use the company's network resources to establish multiple mobile phone pornographic websites. Cheng Wei, Xie Mingshuan, Xie Xu, Wan Shan, Yang Dongsheng, and others respectively operated and managed the websites, which provided pornographic and obscene pictures and texts for others to browse and view, in order to increase the click rate of e-commerce information and advertisements and charge fees paid by advertisers. The illegal proceeds were split between Sheng Xisong and Cheng Wei, Xie Mingshuan, Xie Xu, Wan Shan, etc. on a 7:3 ratio. After defendant Liu Cong was employed by Hefei Tianmei Network Technology Co., Ltd. in early May 2009, he provided 41 obscene novels to Yang Dongsheng, which were made available for browsing and viewing on the mobile phone pornographic website managed by Yang Dongsheng. After the case was discovered, upon appraisal: the website managed by Cheng Wei contained 53,366 obscene pictures and 3,368 obscene novels; the website managed by Xie Mingshuan contained 41,287 obscene pictures and 1,413 obscene novels; the website managed by Xie Xu contained 15,528 obscene pictures and 2,287 obscene novels; the website managed by Wan Shan contained 53,224 obscene pictures and 298 obscene novels; the website managed by Yang Dongsheng contained 40,002 obscene pictures and 97 obscene novels; the 41 obscene novels provided by Liu Cong had a total of 114,814 clicks on the website managed by Yang Dongsheng.

Judgment

The court held that defendant Sheng Xisong, as the legal representative of Hefei Tianmei Network Technology Co., Ltd., for the purpose of the company seeking profits, employed defendants Cheng Wei, Xie Mingshuan, Xie Xu, Wan Shan, Yang Dongsheng, and Liu Cong to establish mobile phone pornographic websites through the Internet to disseminate obscene electronic information. Sheng Xisong is the directly responsible supervisor in the unit crime, and the others are all directly responsible personnel in the unit crime. Moreover, Sheng Xisong, Cheng Wei, Xie Mingshuan, Xie Xu, Wan Shan, and Yang Dongsheng had particularly serious circumstances, and Liu Cong's circumstances were serious. Their conduct has constituted the crime of disseminating obscene materials for profit. Among them, in the course of being responsible for the operation and management of Hefei Tianmei Network Technology Co., Ltd., Sheng Xisong successively employed Cheng Wei, Xie Mingshuan, and five others to establish mobile phone pornographic websites through the Internet to disseminate obscene electronic information, and split the illegal proceeds at a 7:3 ratio; he is the principal offender in the joint crime and shall be punished according to law for all the crimes in which he participated. The other six played secondary roles in the joint crime and are accomplices, and may all be given mitigated punishment according to law. Accordingly, based on the role, circumstances, degree of harm to society, duration of participation in the crime, illegal gains, etc. of each defendant in the unit crime, in accordance with law, defendant Sheng Xisong was sentenced to 11 years and six months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 100,000; Cheng Wei was sentenced to 6 years and six months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 20,000; Xie Mingshuan was sentenced to 5 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 10,000; Xie Xu was sentenced to 3 years and six months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 8,000; Wan Shan was sentenced to 5 years and nine months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 15,000; Yang Dongsheng was sentenced to 3 years and six months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 2,000; Liu Cong was sentenced to 1 year's imprisonment and a fine of RMB 1,000.

Case 5: Zheng Li, Dai Zeyan, Liu Junsong, Zhang Rong, He Jia — Crime of Organizing Obscene Performances

Basic Facts

Defendant Unit: Chongqing Access Technology Co., Ltd.

Defendant Unit: Chongqing Cailan Technology Co., Ltd.

Defendant Unit: Chongqing Jule Network Co., Ltd.

Defendant: Zheng Li, male, Han ethnicity, born on August 25, 1980, legal representative of Chongqing Access Technology Co., Ltd.

Defendant: Dai Zeyan, male, Han ethnicity, born on November 19, 1981, legal representative of Chongqing Cailan Technology Co., Ltd.

Defendant: Liu Junsong, male, Han ethnicity, born on May 23, 1973, legal representative of Chongqing Jule Network Co., Ltd.

Defendant: Zhang Rong, male, Han ethnicity, born on January 19, 1981, president's assistant of Chongqing Access Technology Co., Ltd.

Defendant: He Jia, female, Han ethnicity, born on June 10, 1983, unemployed.

2008年9月，被告人郑立与被告人戴泽焱商议合作建立视频聊天网站，随后两被告人找到重庆市聚乐网络有限公司法定代表人刘峻松，要求被告人刘峻松制作FLASH视频聊天软件。同年10月，郑立要求本公司技术部门开发一个视频聊天网站平台，后该公司技术负责人郑迪与刘峻松将FLASH视频聊天软件上传到视频聊天软件平台上，并于同年11月建立了两个视频聊天网站。2008年12月10日，被告单位重庆访问科技有限公司、重庆彩蓝科技有限公司、重庆市聚乐网络有限公司签订《视频聊天项目合作协议》，协议约定由重庆彩蓝科技有限公司、重庆访问科技有限公司合作经营视频聊天网站（收费型一对一聊天室形式），并负责视频聊天网站的日常运营及管理，重庆市聚乐网络有限公司负责视频聊天系统平台的视频聊天软件的开发以及持续维护更新。协议还约定，重庆彩蓝科技有限公司、重庆访问科技有限公司必须向重庆市聚乐网络有限公司提供推广软件以使重庆市聚乐网络有限公司建立自有推广渠道，重庆市聚乐网络有限公司有权分享自行推广全部收入的65%等内容。此后，郑立、戴泽焱、刘峻松在原有一个聊天网站的基础上，又建立了三个网站，并进行推广，上述四网站最终都指向同一个后台数据库，该数据库由郑立管理。被告人何佳在视频聊天网站中负责招募专职女主播小姐，并对其管理，其管理模式为，专职女主播小姐分三组，每组9~12人，每组设组长一名，组长由何佳管理，专职女主播小姐的收入为固定工资加网民消费提成的20~27%；何佳的收入为固定工资加专职女主播的提成或专项提成。被告人张戎系重庆访问科技有限公司总裁助理，负责联系兼职女主播代理。专职女主播小姐由重庆访问科技有限公司提供固定办公场所及上网的电脑；兼职女主播小姐在家里或其他地方上网，其收入为网民消费提成。网民在网站上注册成为会员后，必须充值2元进入聊天室与女主播聊天，而后，在网站上充值购买K币（虚拟货币1∶100）进入聊天室。网民按照女主播的要求给她在网站里用K币购买虚拟礼物（如别墅、飞机等），按礼物的大小可看见女主播在视频镜头前进行的各种淫秽表演。三被告单位和五被告人利用所招募和联系的女主播、兼职女主播小姐进行淫秽表演牟利。截至2009年6月，上述网站注册用户记录达5703830条，进入聊天室的网民向郑立、戴泽焱在网站上提供的银行账户汇款达232320笔，金额为14931089.39元。

In September 2008, the defendant Zheng Li discussed with the defendant Dai Zeyan the cooperative establishment of a video chat website. Subsequently, the two defendants contacted Liu Junsong, the legal representative of Chongqing Jule Network Co., Ltd., and requested the defendant Liu Junsong to create FLASH video chat software. In October of the same year, Zheng Li instructed the technical department of his company to develop a video chat website platform. Later, the company's technical director Zheng Di and Liu Junsong uploaded the FLASH video chat software to the video chat software platform, and in November of the same year, established two video chat websites. On December 10, 2008, the defendant entities Chongqing Fangwen Technology Co., Ltd., Chongqing Cailan Technology Co., Ltd., and Chongqing Jule Network Co., Ltd. signed the "Video Chat Project Cooperation Agreement." The agreement stipulated that Chongqing Cailan Technology Co., Ltd. and Chongqing Fangwen Technology Co., Ltd. would jointly operate the video chat websites (in the form of paid one-on-one chat rooms) and be responsible for the daily operation and management of the video chat websites, while Chongqing Jule Network Co., Ltd. would be responsible for the development and ongoing maintenance and updates of the video chat software for the video chat system platform. The agreement also stipulated that Chongqing Cailan Technology Co., Ltd. and Chongqing Fangwen Technology Co., Ltd. must provide promotion software to Chongqing Jule Network Co., Ltd. to enable the latter to establish its own promotion channels, and that Chongqing Jule Network Co., Ltd. had the right to share 65% of all revenue from its own promotions, among other terms. Thereafter, Zheng Li, Dai Zeyan, and Liu Junsong established three additional websites based on the original chat website and carried out promotions. All four of the aforementioned websites ultimately pointed to the same backend database, which was managed by Zheng Li. The defendant He Jia was responsible for recruiting full-time female hostesses for the video chat websites and managing them. The management model was as follows: the full-time female hostesses were divided into three groups, each with 9 to 12 persons, and each group had a team leader managed by He Jia. The income of the full-time female hostesses consisted of a fixed salary plus 20% to 27% of the commissions from user spending. He Jia's income consisted of a fixed salary plus commissions from the full-time female hostesses or special commissions. The defendant Zhang Rong was the assistant to the president of Chongqing Fangwen Technology Co., Ltd., responsible for contacting part-time female hostess agents. The full-time female hostesses were provided with a fixed office space and internet-connected computers by Chongqing Fangwen Technology Co., Ltd.; the part-time female hostesses accessed the internet from home or other locations, and their income came from commissions on user spending. After registering as members on the websites, users had to recharge 2 yuan to enter the chat rooms and chat with the female hostesses. Subsequently, they could recharge on the website to purchase K-coins (virtual currency at a rate of 1:100) to enter the chat rooms. Users, following the female hostesses' instructions, used K-coins to purchase virtual gifts (such as villas, airplanes, etc.) on the website, and depending on the size of the gift, they could view various obscene performances by the female hostesses in front of the video camera. The three defendant entities and the five defendants used the recruited and contacted full-time and part-time female hostesses to perform obscene acts for profit. As of June 2009, the aforementioned websites had recorded 5,703,830 registered user accounts, and users entering the chat rooms had made 232,320 remittances to the bank accounts provided on the websites by Zheng Li and Dai Zeyan, totaling RMB 14,931,089.39.

（二）裁判结果

Judgment

法院认为，被告单位重庆访问科技有限公司、重庆彩蓝科技有限公司、重庆市聚乐网络有限公司通过《视频聊天项目合作协议》，由被告人张戎、何佳负责组织招募女主播和联系兼职女主播小姐，采取一对一收费型聊天室，在网络视频上多次组织淫秽表演活动，从中牟利，且持续时间长、观看人数多、社会影响极为恶劣，属情节严重。被告人郑立、戴泽焱、刘峻松、张戎、何佳是组织者，系直接负责的主管人员和其他直接责任人员。三被告单位及五被告人的行为均已构成组织淫秽表演罪。张戎能主动到公安机关投案，并如实供述自己的犯罪事实，是自首，对其可减轻处罚。据此，依法对重庆访问科技有限公司判处罚金人民币1000000元；重庆彩蓝科技有限公司判处罚金人民币800000元；重庆市聚乐网络有限公司判处罚金人民币500000元；郑立判处有期徒刑六年，并处罚金人民币500000元；戴泽焱判处有期徒刑五年六个月，并处罚金人民币400000元；刘峻松判处有期徒刑五年，并处罚金人民币350000元；张戎判处有期徒刑二年六个月，并处罚金人民币100000元；何佳判处有期徒刑三年，并处罚金人民币100000元。

The court held that the defendant entities Chongqing Fangwen Technology Co., Ltd., Chongqing Cailan Technology Co., Ltd., and Chongqing Jule Network Co., Ltd., through the "Video Chat Project Cooperation Agreement," with the defendants Zhang Rong and He Jia responsible for organizing and recruiting female hostesses and contacting part-time female hostesses, adopted a paid one-on-one chat room format and repeatedly organized obscene performance activities on the internet video, thereby profiting. The activities lasted for a long duration, had a large number of viewers, and had an extremely adverse social impact, thus constituting a serious case. The defendants Zheng Li, Dai Zeyan, Liu Junsong, Zhang Rong, and He Jia were the organizers and were directly responsible supervisors and other directly responsible personnel. The actions of the three defendant entities and the five defendants all constituted the crime of organizing obscene performances. Zhang Rong voluntarily surrendered to the public security organ and truthfully confessed his criminal facts, which constituted voluntary surrender, and his punishment could be mitigated. Accordingly, in accordance with the law, Chongqing Fangwen Technology Co., Ltd. was fined RMB 1,000,000; Chongqing Cailan Technology Co., Ltd. was fined RMB 800,000; Chongqing Jule Network Co., Ltd. was fined RMB 500,000; Zheng Li was sentenced to six years' imprisonment and fined RMB 500,000; Dai Zeyan was sentenced to five years and six months' imprisonment and fined RMB 400,000; Liu Junsong was sentenced to five years' imprisonment and fined RMB 350,000; Zhang Rong was sentenced to two years and six months' imprisonment and fined RMB 100,000; He Jia was sentenced to three years' imprisonment and fined RMB 100,000.

案件6

Case 6

苏斌、邱洪峰、沈智伟制作、贩卖淫秽物品牟利、猥亵儿童案

Su Bin, Qiu Hongfeng, Shen Zhiwei — dispute over production and sale of obscene articles for profit and child molestation

（一）基本案情

Basic Facts

被告人苏斌，男，汉族，1983年6月20日出生，无业。
被告人邱洪峰，男，汉族，1966年5月9日出生，某学院工作人员。
被告人沈智伟，男，汉族，1984年10月4日出生，某公司职工。

Defendant Su Bin, male, Han ethnicity, born June 20, 1983, unemployed.
Defendant Qiu Hongfeng, male, Han ethnicity, born May 9, 1966, staff member of a certain college.
Defendant Shen Zhiwei, male, Han ethnicity, born October 4, 1984, employee of a certain company.

2008年至2009年3月间，被告人苏斌为牟取非法利益，利诱程某某、周某、万某、曾某等多名10岁至15岁的男孩，在上海市闵行地区的宾馆、酒店房间内拍摄淫秽片，并由苏斌通过网络，以数十元至上百元不等的价格销售给被告人邱洪峰、沈智伟等人。2008年8月间，苏斌通过网络认识被告人邱洪峰后，先后两次将程某某（1995年6月出生）、周某（1997年8月出生）介绍给邱洪峰，并将上述两人带至邱洪峰入住的闵行饭店，由邱洪峰对上述两名儿童实施猥亵，并从邱处收取人民币6000元。2009年2、3月间，苏斌通过网络认识沈智伟后，将万某（1999年1月出生）介绍给沈智伟，并为其登记入住闵行区格林豪泰上海江川酒店，由沈智伟对万某实施猥亵，四次共收取人民币7400元。2009年3月29日，苏斌被抓获，当场查获574张淫秽照片、78个淫秽视频。同日，沈智伟被抓获。2009年4月13日，邱洪峰接到通知后主动向公安机关投案。

From 2008 to March 2009, for the purpose of obtaining illegal profits, the defendant Su Bin induced multiple boys aged 10 to 15, including Cheng, Zhou, Wan, and Zeng, to film obscene videos in hotel rooms in the Minhang area of Shanghai. Su Bin then sold these videos over the internet to the defendants Qiu Hongfeng, Shen Zhiwei, and others at prices ranging from tens to hundreds of yuan. In August 2008, after meeting the defendant Qiu Hongfeng online, Su Bin twice introduced Cheng (born June 1995) and Zhou (born August 1997) to Qiu Hongfeng, took the two boys to the Minhang Hotel where Qiu Hongfeng was staying, and Qiu Hongfeng molested the two children. Su Bin received RMB 6,000 from Qiu. In February and March 2009, after meeting Shen Zhiwei online, Su Bin introduced Wan (born January 1999) to Shen Zhiwei and checked into the GreenTree Inn Shanghai Jiangchuan Hotel in Minhang District for him, where Shen Zhiwei molested Wan on four occasions. Su Bin received a total of RMB 7,400 from Shen. On March 29, 2009, Su Bin was arrested, and 574 obscene photos and 78 obscene videos were seized at the scene. On the same day, Shen Zhiwei was arrested. On April 13, 2009, Qiu Hongfeng, after receiving notice, voluntarily surrendered to the public security organ.

（二）裁判结果

Judgment

法院认为，被告人苏斌以牟利为目的，制作、贩卖淫秽物品，其行为已构成制作、贩卖淫秽物品牟利罪。苏斌利诱多名不满十四周岁的儿童供被告人邱洪峰、沈智伟猥亵，其行为均已构成猥亵儿童罪，属共同犯罪。苏斌兼犯两罪，依法应当数罪并罚；三名被告人自愿认罪，可酌情从轻处罚；鉴于邱洪峰系初犯，且具有自首情节，社会危害性较小，其所在单位也愿意留用察看，进行监管，对邱洪峰适用缓刑不致再危害社会，故对其判处缓刑。据此，对被告人苏斌以制作、贩卖淫秽物品牟利罪，判处有期徒刑二年，并处罚金人民币5000元；以猥亵儿童罪，判处有期徒刑二年五个月，决定执行有期徒刑三年十一个月，并处罚金人民币5000元。对邱洪峰以猥亵儿童罪，判处有期徒刑一年，缓刑一年。对沈智伟以猥亵儿童罪，判处有期徒刑二年。

The court held that the defendant Su Bin, for the purpose of profit, produced and sold obscene articles, and his actions constituted the crime of producing and selling obscene articles for profit. Su Bin induced multiple children under the age of 14 to be molested by the defendants Qiu Hongfeng and Shen Zhiwei, and his actions all constituted the crime of child molestation, which was joint crimes. Su Bin committed two crimes and should be subject to concurrent punishment for multiple crimes in accordance with the law. All three defendants voluntarily confessed, which could be considered for a lighter punishment. Considering that Qiu Hongfeng was a first-time offender, had the circumstance of voluntary surrender, and the social harm was relatively minor, and his employer was willing to retain him for probation and supervision, applying a suspended sentence to Qiu Hongfeng would not cause further harm to society. Therefore, a suspended sentence was imposed on him. Accordingly, the defendant Su Bin was sentenced to two years' imprisonment and fined RMB 5,000 for the crime of producing and selling obscene articles for profit; and to two years and five months' imprisonment for the crime of child molestation. The combined sentence was fixed at three years and eleven months' imprisonment, with a fine of RMB 5,000. Qiu Hongfeng was sentenced to one year's imprisonment, suspended for one year, for the crime of child molestation. Shen Zhiwei was sentenced to two years' imprisonment for the crime of child molestation.
